Initial registration request rejected because all requested S-NSSAI(s) are rejected and conditions for 5GMM cause #62 are met.

UE initiates initial registration.

Initial registration request rejected due to 5GMM cause #62 "No network slices available".
UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with 5GS registration result value indicating "3GPP access" and is registered over non-3GPP access on the same PLMN or SNPN.

UE completes PLMN selection process after being in PLMN-SEARCH state.
UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT message with 5GS registration result value indicating "3GPP access and non-3GPP access".
